changelog: **Mail delivery: retry outbox and a drain worker; critical mail capped inline (#2944):** a temporary SMTP refusal no longer loses a mail. `sendEmail()` now returns `'SENT' | 'QUEUED' | 'SKIPPED'`: any retryable failure in any lane (a relay throttle, a refused session, a timeout, a 4xx about the message) is put on the queue — an `email.send` `Job` row whose whole envelope is sealed with `secretBox` ('mail-outbox') and cleared on every terminal state, keyed by a natural or hashed de-duplication key, carrying only a sha256 of the recipient — and recorded `EmailLog` DEFERRED instead of FAILED; a 5xx still records FAILED and throws. CRITICAL mail is sent inline through the short-timeout transport with an overall cap (`MAIL_INLINE_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 5 s) and queued past it (the in-flight send cancels the copy if it still goes through); while the relay is paused (the breaker) it is queued at priority 100 without an SMTP attempt. Transactional and bulk mail stay inline by default (`MAIL_QUEUE_LANES` empty). New `src/lib/mailOutbox.ts` (`enqueueMail`, `cancelQueuedMail`, `forgetQueuedMail`, `drainOnce`) and the pure `src/lib/mailWorkerRule.ts` (settle decisions, policy, envelope, breaker; unit-tested with a coverage floor). `POST /api/mail/drain` (CRON_SECRET, or a per-process secret minted at boot where it is unset) is ticked every 5 s from `instrumentation.ts` on every replica, gated by `MAIL_WORKER_ENABLED`; it claims with SKIP LOCKED through a new `names` filter on `claim()`/`reapExpiredLeases()` and never takes a lease. Per row: expiry, budget (`MAIL_METER_MODE=enforce` spends a token; `observe` holds only behind an open breaker), the preference gate again, delivery through the pooled transport, one guarded settle. A relay-wide failure releases rows without charging an attempt and pauses the budget. Callers that read the result treat QUEUED as on its way. Account erasure deletes queued mail by recipient hash; retention prunes settled mail rows after 7 days and dead ones after 30. Deploy scripts forward the `MAIL_*` settings and the canary runs with the worker off. New `check:direct-sendmail` CI guard, `e2e/helpers/fakeSmtp.ts` and `e2e/mail-queue.spec.ts` (smoke: a password reset during a 450 answers in under a second and is delivered after the retry). Docs: `docs/mail-queue.md`.

en: Emails that a mail server temporarily refuses or delays are now queued and retried automatically instead of being lost, and sign-in and password-reset emails no longer keep you waiting when the mail server is slow.
tr: Bir e-posta sunucusunun geçici olarak reddettiği ya da geciktirdiği e-postalar artık kaybolmuyor; sıraya alınıp otomatik olarak yeniden gönderiliyor. E-posta sunucusu yavaş olduğunda giriş ve şifre sıfırlama e-postaları da sizi bekletmiyor.
de: E-Mails, die ein Mailserver vorübergehend ablehnt oder verzögert, gehen nicht mehr verloren: Sie werden in eine Warteschlange gestellt und automatisch erneut gesendet. Anmelde- und Passwort-Zurücksetzen-E-Mails lassen Sie bei einem langsamen Mailserver nicht mehr warten.
